core_obligations: Given the standard Schwarzschild null-geodesic flow,transport energy identity,redshift multiplier and r^p hierarchy,the new core is controlling microscopic radial/momentum derivatives that otherwise grow exponentially near unstable trapping. The authors build a trapping-distance weight from the hyperbolic geodesic structure,project its symplecticgradient onto the null-shell,and introduce a transport-defined correction to the stable commutator to remove an unabsorbable transverseerror. Uniform bounds for the correction and its weighted momentumderivative require incoming,trapped-region and escaping-geodesic analysis in AppendixA. A coupled weightedW1,1 hierarchy with fractional mixed momentum/trapping weights then controls the commutator errors,and a final radialSobolev/momentum integration/absorption removes the relative photon-sphere degeneration. This non-routine trapping-adapted commutator and global weighted-estimate construction is oneH3 mainresult,not the final41-line absorption alone or a separate count for each of57tool labels. The theorem retains its r^-1 log^-2(2+r) spatialbulk weight and fixed-background scope. Author calculations/estimates are preserved without independentcertification.
